description.value: Millionaires' Row Cider Co. is a family-run cidery on a 100+ year-old apple orchard in Summerland's historic Prairie Valley, named for the wealthy investors who shaped the region's early fruit industry. Visitors taste hand-crafted estate ciders at a stand-up bar in the cellar, then can relax in a picnic area surrounded by the working orchard, with views of Conkle Mountain and Giants Head Mountain. The cidery sells its full range of vegan, gluten-free ciders to take away, making it a natural stop on a cycling tour through the South Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms all contact details. The tasting room page explicitly lists 'Ample Parking Available' but makes no specific mention of bike racks or bike-specific parking; the picnic area and outdoor setup are cyclist-friendly but bike parking is unconfirmed. All ciders are labeled 'Vegan and naturally gluten-free' on the product pages. OSM tags the business as craft=brewery, but the website and business name clearly identify it as a cidery.
concerns: OSM tags this business as craft=brewery, but it is a cidery — the tag should be craft=cidery.
OSM has no phone number; 778-381-6015 was sourced from the website and added to the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An operating estate cidery with a tasting room, picnic area with mountain views, and take-away bottles — a compelling and cyclist-appropriate stop on the South Okanagan wine and cider trail.

Takeout.detail: Ciders sold by the bottle at the tasting room; tasting fee waived with any purchase

Packed lunches.detail: Tasting room page says 'Bring your own picnic' — no food sold on site

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: All five cider varieties described as 'Vegan and naturally gluten-free' on the product pages

wow_evidence: family-run cidery on a 100+ year-old apple orchard
